title: GlobalProtect VPN Connection Guide
problem: Employee cannot connect to the corporate VPN using GlobalProtect.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Internet Connection
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Open a public website to confirm your internet connection is working.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Internet Connectivity Check

troubleshooting_steps.title: Enter VPN Portal
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Enter the Bridgestone corporate VPN portal if it is not already configured.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: VPN Portal

troubleshooting_steps.title: Connect
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Click Connect and sign in using your corporate credentials.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: VPN Login

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Connection
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Wait until GlobalProtect shows Connected before accessing internal applications.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: VPN Connected

common_errors.resolution: Verify your username and password. If credentials are correct and the problem persists, request a password reset.
Check your internet connection and reconnect.
Verify the VPN portal address and try again later.

escalation.condition: Escalate if VPN cannot be connected after all troubleshooting steps.

faq.question: Can I use VPN on home Wi-Fi?
faq.answer: Yes. Ensure your internet connection is stable before connecting.

faq.question: Should I reconnect repeatedly?
faq.answer: No. Follow the troubleshooting steps first. If the issue persists after multiple attempts, contact IT.
